# Zohaib DigiForge — Complete LLM & Agent Knowledge Base

## Brand Identity
- **Name**: Zohaib DigiForge
- **Tagline**: Empowering Learning, Powering Success
- **Official Store URL**: https://www.zohaibdigiforge.store
- **Founder**: M Zohaib Shahzad (Lead Software Engineer)
- **Contact Email**: zohaibdigiforge@gmail.com
- **WhatsApp Support**: +92 340 6070632
- **Location**: Rawalpindi / Islamabad, Pakistan (Serving global customers)

## Business Model
Zohaib DigiForge provides accessible, democratized digital resources for creators, students, and businesses in Pakistan and internationally. Standard curated catalog resources are priced at a flat rate of Rs. 279 (approx. $1 USD), including courses, software toolkits, templates, graphics, and e-books.

## Accepted Payment Methods
- JazzCash (Account & Till ID)
- EasyPaisa (Mobile Account)
- SadaPay / NayaPay
- Pakistani Raast & Interbank Bank Transfers (IBFT)
- Binance Pay & USDT / Crypto Transfers

## Delivery Mechanism
All digital resources are delivered instantly via secure Google Drive shared links and direct license key activations immediately after order confirmation. Customers can track their order status anytime at https://www.zohaibdigiforge.store/dashboard using their Order ID.
